Title: Gym Access
Description: Manage the gyms where you are authorized to offer in-person programs.
Authorization meaning: Approved access means GymFlow authorizes you to offer eligible programs at this gym. It does not verify employment.
Meaning APPROVED: You can use this gym when creating or managing eligible in-person programs, while the gym and your authorization remain active.
Meaning PENDING: Awaiting review. Your request has been received.
Meaning REJECTED: This request was not approved. You may submit a new request for an active gym.
Meaning REVOKED: Authorization is no longer active. New gym-linked program use and bookings are restricted; existing historical records remain. You may request access again.
Gym unavailable help: This gym is unavailable. Requests require an active GymFlow gym.
Form help: Choose a venue and explain your relationship. GymFlow reviews each request before authorizing access.
Active gyms help: Only active gyms are listed. Pending or approved venues cannot receive another request.
Gym load error: We could not load the gyms. Please retry.
No gyms: No active gyms match your search.
Checking gym: Checking the gym and your latest access…
Duplicate help: Your latest access is {{status}}. Another request cannot be submitted for this gym.
Pair error: We could not check your latest access. Reload before submitting.
Submit error: We could not confirm this request. Your draft is saved here. Reload your latest access before trying again.
Relationship help: Describe your relationship to the venue. This is not an employment verification.
Note help: Explain why you need access in 10–1000 characters, excluding surrounding spaces. Do not include private documents or sensitive information.
Note validation: Enter between 10 and 1000 characters, excluding surrounding spaces.
